name: Jarvis
changes_cs: Zahlavi Jarvise a setupu ted ukazuje produktovou ikonu pred nazvem a build verzi hned za nazvem aplikace. Stejne pravidlo bylo doplneno do WDUi sablony a CPM pravidel pro dalsi native appky.
changes_en: Jarvis app and setup title bars now show the product icon before the app name and the build version immediately after the app name. The same rule was added to the WDUi template and CPM rules for future native apps.

history.changes_cs: Zahlavi Jarvise a setupu ted ukazuje produktovou ikonu pred nazvem a build verzi hned za nazvem aplikace. Stejne pravidlo bylo doplneno do WDUi sablony a CPM pravidel pro dalsi native appky.
history.changes_en: Jarvis app and setup title bars now show the product icon before the app name and the build version immediately after the app name. The same rule was added to the WDUi template and CPM rules for future native apps.

history.changes_cs: Cista instalace Jarvise uz startuje s providerem Ollama a predvyplnenymi max-hvezdickovymi modelovymi profily pro chat, rychle odpovedi, programovani, premysleni a obrazky. Chybejici Ollama model se pri prvnim pouziti pripravi automaticky bez rucniho prikazu.
history.changes_en: A clean Jarvis install now starts with the Ollama provider and prefilled max-star model profiles for chat, quick replies, coding, reasoning, and images. A missing Ollama model is prepared automatically on first use without a manual command.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis Setup po instalaci a preinstalaci uz neotevira hlavni okno Jarvise behem prubehoveho nebo vysledkoveho setup dialogu. Viditelny Jarvis se spusti az po zavreni setupoveho okna; tichy --restart-app update tok zustava zachovan.
history.changes_en: Jarvis Setup no longer opens the main Jarvis window while the progress or result setup dialog is still visible. The visible Jarvis window starts only after the setup window closes, while the silent --restart-app update flow remains supported.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis byl znovu sestaven a publikovan s aktualnimi CPM metadata, setupem a checksumem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis was rebuilt and published with current CPM metadata, setup, and checksum.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis sjednocuje ikony v setupu, tray a Windows taskbaru: male ICO frame jsou odvozene z nove 3D Jarvis ikony a aplikace i setup explicitne nastavuji velkou i malou window ikonu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis unifies setup, tray, and Windows taskbar icons: small ICO frames are derived from the new 3D Jarvis icon and both the app and setup explicitly set large and small window icons.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis zjednodusuje vyber modelu: zbytecna tlacitka Pouzit/Chat/Kod/Obrazky jsou pryc, comboboxy radi modely podle vhodnosti pro dany profil a ukazuji 3D hvezdickove doporuceni. WDUi Control umi hostovat child controly primo z base tridy.
history.changes_en: Jarvis simplifies model selection: redundant Use/Chat/Code/Images buttons are removed, combo boxes sort models by suitability for each profile and show 3D star recommendations. WDUi Control can host child controls directly from the base class.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis uz v beznem modelovem UI nezobrazuje prikazovy model-manager tahak. Sprava modelu se otevre jako okno Model pro praci a omylove profilove/modelove akce vraci lidske sdeleni misto prikazove syntaxe.
history.changes_en: Jarvis no longer shows the command-style model-manager cheat sheet in the normal model UI. Model management opens the Model for work window, and accidental profile/model actions return human-readable guidance instead of command syntax.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri instalaci a aktualizaci znovu osadi produktovou ikonu, Start Menu ikonu a obnovi cache ikon Windows, aby se po updatu zobrazila nova Jarvis ikona.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now reapplies the product icon, Start Menu icon, and Windows shell icon cache during install and update so the new Jarvis icon appears after updating.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri instalaci a pri stazeni modelu spolehliveji pripravuje lokalni modelove prostredi: po instalaci pres Windows Package Manager dele ceka na Ollamu, umi spustit i Ollama app fallback, setup spousti pull vybraneho default modelu a vysledkovy dialog stazeni modelu je lidsky misto technickeho logu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now prepares the local model environment more reliably during setup and model download: it waits longer after Windows Package Manager installs Ollama, can start the Ollama app fallback, setup starts pulling the selected default model, and the model-download result dialog is human-readable instead of a technical log.

history.changes_cs: Panel Projekt / workspace ma vic mista: vstup slozky, vyber projektu a podklady maji vetsi vysku, rozestupy a spodni odsazeni.
history.changes_en: The Project / workspace panel has more room: folder input, project actions, and sources now have taller controls, clearer spacing, and safer bottom padding.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis ma novou vlastni ikonu: guide-following AAA 3D sci-fi render s jasnym J command core a rucne citelnymi malymi ICO framy pro tray/taskbar.
history.changes_en: Jarvis has a new custom icon: a guide-following AAA 3D sci-fi render with a clear J command core and hand-readable small ICO frames for tray/taskbar use.

history.changes_cs: Rozvolneny horni chatovy panel: status, fronta a progressbar maji vice mista a mene se tlaci na okraje.
history.changes_en: Loosened the top chat panel so status, queue, and progress controls have more breathing room.

history.changes_cs: Modelovy popup ma novou uzivatelskou knihovnu modelu: ukazuje bezne lokalni modely, stav dostupnosti, lidske popisy a tlacitka pro pouziti v chatu, programovani nebo obrazcich. Pres Ollamu umi vybrany model pripravit po potvrzeni.
history.changes_en: The model popup now includes a user-facing model library with common local model choices, availability status, plain-language descriptions, and buttons to use a model for chat, coding, or images. With Ollama, Jarvis can prepare the selected model after confirmation.

history.changes_cs: Spodni duplicitni tlacitko Nastaveni bylo odstraneno. Nastaveni zustava v levem panelu, aby composer zustal cistsi.
history.changes_en: The duplicate bottom Settings button was removed. Settings remains available from the left panel so the composer stays cleaner.

history.changes_cs: Nastaveni modelu uz neukazuje ani nevyzaduje rucni Endpoint. Jarvis voli lokalni pripojeni automaticky podle provideru a pri zmene provideru obnovi seznam modelu.
history.changes_en: Model settings no longer show or require a manual Endpoint. Jarvis chooses the local connection automatically from the selected provider and refreshes model lists when the provider changes.

history.changes_cs: Progress v hornim chat panelu je zkraceny a zarovnany ke stavovym chipum, aby nelezl pres akcni cast panelu.
history.changes_en: The progress indicator in the top chat panel is shorter and aligned with the status chips so it no longer spans across the action area.

history.changes_cs: Tlacitko Pridat ve spodnim chatu je nove bitmapove akcni tlacitko pro pridani souboru, obrazku a podkladu; asset ma samostatne normal/hot/pressed/disabled stavy.
history.changes_en: The bottom chat Add action is now a bitmap button for adding files, images, and source material, with dedicated normal/hot/pressed/disabled states.

history.changes_cs: Ikonka aktualizace v titulku se uz nedeformuje podle tlacitka. WDUi titlebar glyphy se kresli se zachovanym pomerem stran a vertikalne i horizontalne centrovane uvnitr tlacitka.
history.changes_en: The title-bar update icon is no longer distorted by the button shape. WDUi title-bar glyphs are now drawn with preserved aspect ratio and centered vertically and horizontally inside the button.

history.changes_cs: Panel Projekt / workspace ma opravenou vysku a rozestupy: viditelna napoveda uz nekryje vstup slozky, tlacitka Podklady zustavaji uvnitr karty a chat transcript zacina az pod panelem.
history.changes_en: The Project / workspace panel now has corrected height and spacing: visible help no longer overlaps the folder input, Sources controls stay inside the card, and the chat transcript starts below the panel.

history.changes_cs: Progressbar v horni chat karte ma opravenou layoutovou kotvu: uz neplave jako pravostranny prvek, neprekryva frontu prace a pri zmene sirky se roztahuje v ramci chat karty.
history.changes_en: The progress bar in the top chat card now has the correct layout anchor: it no longer floats as a right-side control, does not overlap the work queue row, and stretches within the chat card when the window width changes.

history.changes_cs: Nastaveni Jarvise uz neobsahuje duplicitni tlacitka Zkontrolovat update, Nainstalovat update ani Sprava chatu; update zustava v hlavicce/menu/tray a sprava chatu v kontextu chatu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis Settings no longer duplicates Check update, Install update, or Chat management buttons; updates stay in the titlebar/menu/tray and chat management stays in the chat context.

history.changes_cs: Nastaveni Jarvise uz neukazuje dlouhe vysvetlujici texty pro internet a bezpecnost; tyto informace jsou presunute do tooltipu a dialog je kompaktnejsi.
history.changes_en: Jarvis Settings no longer shows long explanatory internet/security text; the details moved into tooltips and the dialog is more compact.

history.changes_cs: UI aktualizace Jarvise ted pouziva WDUi dialogy pro kontrolu, stazeni a instalaci a nezapisuje technicky update vystup do chatu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis UI update actions now use WDUi dialogs for check, download, and install progress without writing technical update output into chat.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis odstranil z levého panelu zbytečné tlačítko Správa chatu; akce chatu zůstávají v kontextovém popupu nad chatem, takže sidebar je klidnější.
history.changes_en: Jarvis removed the redundant Chat management button from the left sidebar; chat actions remain available from the chat context popup, keeping the sidebar calmer.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis Setup je ted single-instance a interaktivni instalace, preinstalace i odinstalace bezi pres viditelny prubehovy dialog na worker vlakne, takze opakovane spusteni uz nezamrazi UI a update ceka na starou instanci jen kratce.
history.changes_en: Jarvis Setup is now single-instance, and interactive install, reinstall, and uninstall run through a visible worker-thread progress dialog, so repeated launches no longer freeze the UI and updates wait for the old instance only briefly.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis a sdilene WDUi okno se pri maximalizaci chovaji jako normalni Windows aplikace: respektuji pracovni plochu monitoru a neprekryvaji Windows taskbar.
history.changes_en: Jarvis and the shared WDUi window host now maximize like normal Windows applications: they respect the monitor work area and do not cover the Windows taskbar.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri instalaci a odpovedich automaticky pripravuje lokalni Ollama prostredi, umi doplnit Ollamu pres Windows Package Manager, probudit server, stahnout vybrany model a misto technickeho HTTP logu ukazuje lidske shrnuti.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now automatically prepares the local Ollama environment during setup and answers, can install Ollama through Windows Package Manager, wake the server, pull the selected model, and shows a human-readable status instead of raw HTTP diagnostics.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis odstranil duplicitni horni tlacitka Novy chat, Model a Nastaveni; Novy chat zustava vlevo a model/nastaveni zustavaji ve spodnim composeru.
history.changes_en: Jarvis removed duplicate top New chat, Model, and Settings buttons; New chat remains in the sidebar and model/settings remain in the bottom composer.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri obrazove priloze po probuzeni lokalniho provideru automaticky vybere Vision profil, vision-capable nakonfigurovany model nebo vision-capable model nahlaseny providerem.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now wakes the local provider for image attachments and automatically chooses the Vision profile, a configured vision-capable model, or a provider-reported vision-capable model.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis Model popup vybira vsechny modelove profily z comboboxu s popisy a obrazove prilohy automaticky preferuji Vision model.
history.changes_en: Jarvis Model popup now selects all model profiles from tooltip-backed comboboxes, and image attachments automatically prefer a Vision model.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri obrazove priloze automaticky preferuje Vision model nebo vision-capable profil a Model popup vybira modely z comboboxu s popisem misto rucniho psani.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now automatically prefers a Vision model or vision-capable profile for image attachments, and the Model popup selects models from tooltip-backed comboboxes instead of typed model IDs.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis pri obrazove priloze automaticky preferuje Vision model nebo vision-capable profil a modelove nastaveni pridava samostatny Vision profil.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now automatically prefers a Vision model or vision-capable profile for image attachments, and model settings include a dedicated Vision profile.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis posila bezny chat pres lokalni model s recentnim kontextem a pri Ollama provideru se pokusi automaticky probudit lokalni model server pred odpovedi.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now sends ordinary chat through the local model with recent conversation context and attempts to auto-start the Ollama local model server before replying.

history.changes_cs: Chat po dokonceni prace sbali Jarvisovy pracovni komentare do rozklikavaciho souhrnu, aby konverzace zustala prehledna.
history.changes_en: After a job finishes, Jarvis collapses work progress comments into an expandable summary so the chat stays clean.

history.changes_cs: Pridava vychozi pracovni slozku pro chaty bez projektu. Jarvis ted pouziva Documents\\Jarvis jako viditelny sandbox, kdyz chat nema konkretni projektovou slozku.
history.changes_en: Adds a default workspace for chats without a project. Jarvis now uses Documents\\Jarvis as a visible sandbox when a chat has no concrete project folder.

history.changes_cs: Pridava obrazky v chatu: Ctrl+V/vyber souboru, lokalni ulozeni, vision payload pro Ollama a LM Studio. Kontextove menu chatu se zavira klikem mimo nej.
history.changes_en: Adds chat image attachments: Ctrl+V/file picker, local storage, vision payloads for Ollama and LM Studio. Chat context popup now closes when clicking outside.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis odpovida na kratke pozdravy lokalne jeste pred routerem a modelem, takze Ahoj funguje i kdyz Ollama nebo jiny lokalni model server zrovna nebezi. Dokumentace zaroven upresnuje pravidlo chat-first agenta: Jarvis ma pusobit jako normalni chat s agentickymi schopnostmi pod nim.
history.changes_en: Jarvis now answers short greetings locally before router and model work, so Ahoj works even when Ollama or another local model server is not running. The documentation also clarifies the chat-first agent rule: Jarvis should feel like a normal chat with agent capabilities underneath.

history.changes_cs: Chat a stav Jarvise uz neukazuji router/model/HTTP detaily; technicke worker vystupy se filtruji a selhani modelu se zobrazi lidsky.
history.changes_en: Jarvis chat and status no longer show router/model/HTTP details; technical worker output is filtered and model failures are shown in plain human wording.

history.changes_cs: Chat uz nevykresluje technicke hlavičky Antonin/Jarvis; uzivatelske zpravy jsou bubliny s casem a Jarvisovy komentare pusobi jako prirozena konverzace.
history.changes_en: Chat no longer renders raw Antonin/Jarvis headers; user prompts are bubbles with time labels and Jarvis work comments read like natural conversation.

history.changes_cs: Rychle akce spravy chatu jsou dostupne pravym klikem na chat v levem panelu.
history.changes_en: Chat management quick actions are available by right-clicking a chat in the left sidebar.
